aiResearchSummary.text: Capy is focused on developing an authentication system that enhances security through biometric authentication. The system involves an application server that sends biometric authentication requests to an authentication server, aiming to improve user verification processes. This aligns with Capy's mission to provide SaaS-based security solutions, particularly in the realm of authentication and CAPTCHA technologies.
